Output(10,1," >Y-VARS, fnInt(Y₁,X,a,b)")
Repeat Ans:getKey:End
Ans→K
If K=45:Goto 5
If K=24:Goto BZ
Lbl B1
ClrHome
Output(1,1,"TI-84 fnInt/nDeriv     3/3")
Output(2,1,"MATH > PRB menu")
Output(3,1," 2 nPr   3 nCr   4 !")
Output(4,1," e.g. 12 nCr 3 = 220")
Output(5,1,"      5 nPr 2 = 20")
Output(6,1,"      5! = 120")
Output(7,1,"Fraction template")
Output(8,1," ALPHA Y= (F1) 1 n/d")
Output(9,1,"TOOL CALC>RV>4 runs fnInt")
Output(10,1," for any f(x) or F(x)")
Repeat Ans:getKey:End
Ans→K
If K=45:Goto 5
If K=24:Goto B0
Goto 5
Lbl Z
ClrHome
Return
